title: Seam-Free Multi-Sensor Steger-Blakely Contact Localization & Multi-Scale Steerable Curvilinear Centerline Propagation (H73-MCSC)

E1_sensor_submod.description: Single-regime global 52-channel de-regionalized multi-sensor LightGBM posterior (1m LiDAR + 10m DEM + fluvial chi + 19-band GeoDAWN + GDR-1391 thermal conduits + ScienceBase heat flow; 0 catalogue-distance covariates) + exact 300m triangular-kernel submodular max-cover at matched 37,654 off-catalogue binary dots (d_vis > 2.0 px).

E2_seamfree_blakely_submod.description: Adds 15 closed-form scale-normalized Steger (1998) / Blakely-Simpson (1986) sub-pixel 1D fault/contact crests across LiDAR, 10m/100m DEM, gravity, magnetics, and basement depth, fused via Dual-Regime Seam-Free Cross-Tile Quantile Calibration (Expert_All67 + LiDAR-free Expert_NoLiDAR51 trained across 100% of training quadrants to eliminate the 47.4% NE Nevada 3DEP LiDAR gap starvation) + exact 300m submodular max-cover at matched 37,654 dots.

E3_mcsc_seamfree_curvilinear.description: Full 2-Stage H73-MCSC Multi-Scale Steerable Curvilinear Centerline Propagation (12 azimuths x 3 scales: 900m, 2.3km, 4.5km blind-gap bridges, bilateral half-ray continuity min(I+, I-), perpendicular flank-subtracted crestness, and smooth cos 2theta / sin 2theta strike kinematics) over the seam-free Steger-Blakely posterior + directional across-strike apron suppression & 300m submodular max-cover at matched 37,654 dots.
